resources.string: On Android 16, Manage may open the Health Connect app list instead of this package\'s page. Select HealthChecker+ Companion, then adjust permissions.
Observational companion only — not a diagnosis. BP is not continuous. ECG unsupported in HC-303A. Background WorkManager is best-effort.
HealthChecker+ reads selected Health Connect records you authorize and delivers them to your local Health Vault host. No medication advice is provided.
Pairing state is inconsistent. Re-pair with your Health Vault host. Existing credentials were not erased.
